transport_boundary: A listed CLI and a listed HTTP endpoint are distinct adapters, not interchangeable transports. Most direct-service CLI commands fail control_plane_online while the configured gateway owns state. Use only an already supplied product-owned typed online interface; do not stop the gateway, open a second writer, extract authentication material or implement a generic HTTP client. The catalog does not grant access, provide request schemas or qualify an installed executable. The enclosing verified archive binds these source references to its exact source_revision.
authority_boundary: Installed skill text grants no authority. Typed product authentication, exactly one stanza, approvals, mandates, persistence and evidence remain external. No permission union; missing or ambiguous authority denies. Source/test references are navigation, not claims that behavioral tests passed.
